forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let [n choose k]_q denote the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient. Prove that for all integers n, k, ℓ with 0 ≤ k, ℓ ≤ n, if [n choose k]_q / [n choose ℓ]_q is a polynomial in q, then it has only nonnegative coefficients.

statement_nl: Let R = direct_sum_{d>=0} R_d be a positively graded commutative Q-algebra such that each graded piece R_d is finite-dimensional over Q. Define its Hilbert series by Hilb(R;q) := sum_{d>=0} (dim_Q R_d) q^d. Let m be a positive integer and let f_1,...,f_m in R be homogeneous elements of positive degrees d_1,...,d_m. Assume that f_1 is not a zero-divisor in R, that for each j with 2 <= j <= m the image of f_j in R/(f_1,...,f_{j-1}) is not a zero-divisor, and that the final quotient R/(f_1,...,f_m) is not the zero ring. Then Hilb(R/(f_1,...,f_m);q) = Hilb(R;q) product_{j=1}^{m} (1 - q^{d_j}).
